si_appendix.how: Already present in source/ when this curation began. VERIFIED to be the publisher's copy: the Europe PMC supplementaryFiles archive for PMC12625924 contains a member of the same name whose md5 is identical (2cc017f11f6052cc887002a0500c0c8e).

figures.how: GET https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC12625924/supplementaryFiles?includeInlineImage=true -> application/zip, 2271106 bytes, 11 members. Extracted into its own empty directory. Validated as a real ZIP by zipfile, and each member validated by magic bytes before use (the first fetch of the same URL without includeInlineImage returned a TRUNCATED archive, 241664 bytes, whose end-of-central-directory signature was missing -- caught by the magic-byte/structure check and re-fetched, not worked around).

full_text.how: GET https://www.ebi.ac.uk/europepmc/webservices/rest/PMC12625924/fullTextXML (JATS, 111976 bytes). Used for the Results and Methods prose and for every printed numeral quoted in 05_values.csv and 08_contradictions.csv. Not stored in source/ because it is regenerable from a stable REST endpoint keyed on the PMCID.
full_text.note: No article PDF is served: .../PMC12625924/fullTextPDF returns HTTP 404. The PMC asset route https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/instance/12625924/bin/<name> was tried at 35 s pacing and returns byte-identical 796x671 JPEGs, so 796x671 IS the publisher deposit resolution and no higher-resolution raster exists. No bot check was encountered and none was bypassed.

native_resolution_measured._what: px / rect_pt * 72 for every SI figure, measured rather than assumed.
native_resolution_measured.method: pymupdf get_image_info(xrefs=True) bbox against the embedded pixel dimensions
native_resolution_measured.main_figures: Standalone JPEGs with no PDF rect, so no px/pt measurement is possible. The JFIF header declares 300x300 dpi, which is a DECLARATION and not a measurement; the figures were therefore handled by their measured per-panel resolution in data units instead -- 0.5666 and 0.5682 percent per pixel for Fig. 2B's two panels, 0.5207 for Fig. 3D.

deposits.repository_search: provenance/tools/find_repo.py --pmid 41183194 --title 'Glycolipid nanoparticles spleen detarget liver' --author Gentry: 5 queries, 0 repo hits, 0 candidates, 15 filtered out as unrelated.
deposits.what_the_deposit_actually_contains: Unaligned scRNA-seq reads from the splenic single-cell experiment. No barcode count table, no normalized delivery value, no LNP identity mapping. An accession is not a delivery value.
deposits.publisher_source_data: NONE. The Europe PMC supplementary archive holds the SI PDF and the five figure rasters and nothing else.
deposits.data_availability_statement: All other data are included in the article and/or SI Appendix.
